title: EUCR-3C - Electronic undercurrent relay, 3 CT, fail-safe, 0.5–60 A
range_short_desc: Analogue undercurrent (dry-run) relay, three-CT fail-safe version
description: Older analogue EUCR-3C electronic undercurrent relay for three-phase motors and other under-current applications. Three integral current transformers, fail-safe (normally energized) operation and a 2-SPST (1a1b) output. Load cables pass through the integral CTs; circuits up to 600 A are covered by using the 05 type with standard 5 A metering CTs, and for single-phase one external CT is fed through all three integral CTs. Front-panel O-TIME and LOAD dials are calibrated so the relay can be set with no control power applied.

feature_groups.title: Applications
items: Pumping cavitation or loss of prime

100–600 : 05 type fitted to external CT (current ratio 100/5 A – 600/5 A)

Control voltages : 24 V AC/DC, 110 (85–150 V AC), 220 (180–260 V AC), 440 (320–480 V AC)
Output relay : independent volt-free contact, 3 A / 250 V AC resistive
Insulation : over 10 MΩ at 500 V DC between casing and circuits
Dielectric strength : casing/circuit 2 kV, between contacts 1 kV, between circuits 2 kV
Current range : 05, 30, 60, or 100–600 with external current transformers
